data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for discovering network and WiFi details.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to discover network information such as WiFi name, BSSID, IP address, IPv6, submask, broadcast, and gateway IP. Supports Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, and Windows platforms.
use_when: You need to retrieve the current WiFi SSID or BSSID inside your app
You need to know the device's local network IP configuration
avoid_when: You are targeting the Web platform where network info is not supported
You cannot meet platform-specific permission requirements for location or WiFi information
strengths: Cross-platform support covering Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, and Windows
Part of the official fluttercommunity plus plugins set
weaknesses: Requires specific location and network state permissions on Android and iOS to fetch WiFi details
iOS restricts WiFi SSID/BSSID retrieval unless specific conditions and entitlements are met
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific configuration such as location permissions on Android, and 'Access Wi-Fi information' entitlement and location usage descriptions on iOS.
